ideas.pitch: A Python-based AI soccer agent trained using the NeuroEvolution of Augmenting Topologies (NEAT) algorithm to automatically evolve optimal scoring and defending behaviors within the 2D arena.
ideas.title: NEAT-Soccer: Evolutionary 2D Football Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a proven evolutionary algorithm approach from similar high-performing robotics and racing agents, guaranteeing robust handling of randomized obstacles and evaluation seeds.

ideas.pitch: A deterministic, high-performance rule-based soccer agent using geometric pathfinding and predictive vector math to intercept opponents, block shots, and execute clean counter-attacks.
ideas.title: GoalGuard: Finite State Machine and Heuristic Defensive Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: In deterministic 2D physics engines with strict time limits, finely tuned heuristic control systems often outperform unstable ML models because they never miss a predictable interception vector.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous football agent trained via Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) using stable-baselines3, customized with a reward function tailored specifically for ball possession, shot accuracy, and defensive positioning.
ideas.title: ReinforcementStriker: PPO-Trained Autonomous Football Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuine ML engineering by training a reinforcement learning policy directly inside a simulation loop optimized for head-to-head tournament evaluation.

ideas.pitch: A modular soccer agent structured around behavior trees, enabling dynamic switching between offensive striker modes, defensive wall formations, and panic clearance routines depending on live ball telemetry.
ideas.title: TacticalTree: Behavior Tree Driven Soccer Strategist
ideas.why_it_could_win: Behavior trees offer predictable, easy-to-debug state transitions which prevent common edge-case failures like getting stuck against arena boundaries during chaotic matches.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent agent that uses A-star grid planning combined with physics-based kinematic prediction to calculate multi-step ball trajectories and outmaneuver opposing bots around random obstacles.
ideas.title: A-Star Striker: Pathfinding and Predictive Trajectory Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the obstacle navigation and interception sub-problems with rigorous computer science pathfinding algorithms, ensuring reliable execution across hidden evaluation seeds.
